title: Intel has its first customer for its most advanced manufacturing process
author: B
text:
B

Brady
Well-known member

Intel said Wednesday that the chipmaker has the first client for its leading-edge 18A manufacturing technology, a milestone in the company’s effort to become a contract manufacturer.

“We just signed the first customer,” CEO Lip-Bu Tan said at the TomorrowX investment conference in Austin, according to remarks provided by the company. Tan didn’t name the customer or specify financial terms of the deal. Intel had indicated previously that it usually would not identify individual clients.
